svg.title: Modern World History
svg.desc: 106 selected histories. Time flows from 1450 AD at the top to 2026 AD at the bottom on one linear scale. Seven fixed regional columns. Concurrent histories share equal widths; width carries no prominence score. Select a block for Wikipedia, dates and its sizing explanation.
